main_body: Flat-roofed sandstone building: a sand-coloured roof terrace with a teal dome on top, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a lattice window
top_band: Sand/tan roof terrace with a lighter front lip, rows ~2-33, speckled and enclosed by a parapet rim on the left, right and back
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a parapet edge and a large speckled sand roof surface (rows 2-31), a light front-edge lip (rows 31-33), a dark brown eave shadow (rows 34-36), then the brick front wall (rows 36-65). The wall carries an arched door with a white frame and dark inner planks, and a window with a lattice and a sill. The roof is a clearly horizontal surface seen from above, with a dome standing on it, and it is not just a thin band. It is tall for a foreshortened top, but it reads as a flat terrace roof and the wall below is a distinct vertical face.

style.evidence: The dome has about 5 teal steps with highlight clumps. The bricks use 3-4 tones with dark brown mortar lines, and the roof has sand speckle and a parapet shading ramp. Outlines are a dark brown that leans with the material, not near-black. The door planks and the right side of the roof are somewhat flat, and there are no per-tile scallops like the reference, so it is a little thinner than the reference. A careful artist would still accept it next to the reference.
